functional_requirements.FR1: User Registration and Authentication: Users should be able to create accounts, log in securely, and manage their profiles (including address book and payment methods).
functional_requirements.details: Implement secure password storage and recovery mechanisms.  Support different authentication methods (e.g., email/password, social login).

functional_requirements.FR2: Product Catalog Management: Administrators should be able to add, edit, and delete product information (name, description, price, specifications, images, inventory levels, categories).
functional_requirements.details: Support multiple product images and detailed specifications.  Allow for hierarchical category structures.  Implement product search functionality (keyword, category, filters).

functional_requirements.FR3: Shopping Cart Functionality: Users should be able to add products to a shopping cart, view the cart contents, update quantities, and remove items.
functional_requirements.details: Support persistent shopping carts (cart contents saved across sessions). Display cart subtotal, shipping costs, and total cost.

functional_requirements.FR4: Order Processing: Users should be able to place orders, select shipping addresses and payment methods, and review order details before submitting.
functional_requirements.details: Integrate with payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, PayPal). Generate order confirmations and track order status.  Implement order cancellation functionality (within a defined timeframe).

functional_requirements.FR5: Inventory Management: The system should track inventory levels and automatically update quantities when orders are placed or inventory is restocked.
functional_requirements.details: Send alerts when inventory levels are low. Support batch inventory updates.  Integrate with supplier systems (optional).

functional_requirements.FR6: Search Functionality: Users should be able to search for products based on keywords, categories, and filters (e.g., price range, brand, specifications).
functional_requirements.details: Implement fuzzy search and auto-suggestions. Allow for sorting search results (e.g., price, popularity, relevance).

functional_requirements.FR7: Customer Support: Provide a contact form or live chat functionality for users to ask questions and receive assistance.
functional_requirements.details: Integrate with a customer support ticketing system (optional).  Provide FAQs and knowledge base articles.

functional_requirements.FR8: Reviews and Ratings: Allow users to submit reviews and ratings for products.
functional_requirements.details: Moderate reviews to prevent spam and inappropriate content. Display average product ratings.

functional_requirements.FR9: Wishlist Functionality: Allow users to save products to a wishlist for later purchase.
functional_requirements.details: Allow users to share their wishlists with others. Send notifications when wishlist items are on sale.

functional_requirements.FR10: Sales and Promotions: Administrators should be able to create and manage sales promotions (e.g., discounts, coupons).
functional_requirements.details: Support different types of discounts (e.g., percentage off, fixed amount off).  Track coupon usage and expiration dates.

functional_requirements.FR11: Reporting and Analytics: Provide administrators with reports on sales data, inventory levels, and customer behavior.
functional_requirements.details: Generate reports on popular products, sales trends, and customer demographics.  Integrate with analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics).

non_functional_requirements.NFR1: Performance: The website should load quickly and respond to user requests in a timely manner.
non_functional_requirements.details: Page load times should be less than 3 seconds.  The system should be able to handle a large number of concurrent users.

non_functional_requirements.NFR2: Security: The website should be secure and protect user data from unauthorized access.
non_functional_requirements.details: Implement secure coding practices to prevent vulnerabilities (e.g., SQL injection, cross-site scripting).  Use SSL encryption for all data transmission.  Comply with relevant data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

non_functional_requirements.NFR3: Scalability: The website should be able to handle increasing traffic and data volume without performance degradation.
non_functional_requirements.details: Use a scalable architecture that can be easily expanded as needed.  Implement caching mechanisms to improve performance.

non_functional_requirements.NFR4: Usability: The website should be easy to use and navigate, with a clear and intuitive user interface.
non_functional_requirements.details: Conduct user testing to identify and address usability issues.  Follow established usability guidelines.

non_functional_requirements.NFR5: Reliability: The website should be reliable and available 24/7.
non_functional_requirements.details: Implement robust error handling and recovery mechanisms.  Use a reliable hosting provider with redundant infrastructure.

non_functional_requirements.NFR6: Maintainability: The website should be easy to maintain and update.
non_functional_requirements.details: Use a modular architecture and well-documented code.  Implement automated testing to ensure code quality.

non_functional_requirements.NFR7: Accessibility: The website should be accessible to users with disabilities.
non_functional_requirements.details: Comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).  Provide alternative text for images and captions for videos.

non_functional_requirements.NFR8: Compatibility: The website should be compatible with different browsers and devices.
non_functional_requirements.details: Test the website on a variety of browsers and devices.  Use responsive design to ensure optimal viewing experience on different screen sizes.

non_functional_requirements.NFR9: Legal Compliance:  The system must comply with all relevant legal and regulatory requirements, including data privacy laws, consumer protection laws, and sales tax regulations.
non_functional_requirements.details: Ensure adherence to GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable laws. Provide clear terms and conditions and privacy policies.
